description: Return one dataset card from /datasets/<id>/card.json. Output is one object: id, name, publisher, url, license (string or null), license_verified, license_url (string or null), approx_size, size_bytes (integer or null), format, access (open, login, or terms-acceptance), relevance, mirror_allowed, verified_at, http_status (integer or null), archive_url (string or null), data_period (string or null), sample_url (string or null), and notes. A card is metadata only and does not download dataset files; follow url for the data. Parameter id is required and must match list_datasets entries[].id. Example: agentpaywire-library. Do not include the dataset: prefix that list_changes uses. A missing id is rejected as invalid input. An unknown id returns isError with text Fetch failed 404 <card url>. A failed read for another status uses that same Fetch failed <status> <url> text. Use list_datasets instead when you need the catalog or do not know the id. Use search_sources with category datasets-benchmarks instead for papers about datasets. Free, no auth.

id.description: Required. Dataset id exactly as in list_datasets entries[].id, e.g. agentpaywire-library. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Do not include the dataset: prefix that list_changes uses. A missing id is invalid input. An unknown id returns isError text Fetch failed 404 <card url>.

name: get_dataset
title: Get one dataset card
